title: tf.summary.create_file_writer crashes when non-scalar values are passed to flush_millis parameter
cwe: CWE-703: Improper Check or Handling of Exceptional Conditions
trigger_payload:
import tensorflow as tf
import numpy as np
tf.summary.create_file_writer(logdir='', flush_millis=np.ones((1,2)))
oracle: process aborts with F tensorflow/core/framework/tensor.cc:669] Check failed: 1 == Nu
